subject: general
question: EMISAT is which type of satellite launched by ISRO?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Intelligence satellite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **EMISAT** is a satellite launched by ISRO primarily for **electronic intelligence gathering**.
 
• It was launched on **April 1, 2019**, using the **PSLV-C45** rocket.
 
• The satellite is intended to **gather information related to radar signals** and other electronic emissions.
 
• EMISAT is equipped with advanced payloads to support **strategic and defense purposes** for India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Remote-sensing satellite:**

 
 
• These satellites are used for **observing and gathering data** about the Earth's surface.
 
• They play a crucial role in **agriculture, forestry, land-use mapping, urban planning, and disaster management**.
 
• ISRO has launched several remote-sensing satellites, including the **Cartosat and Resourcesat series**.
 
 
 
• **Communications satellite:**
 
 
• These satellites enable **telecommunication, broadcasting, and internet services**.
 
• They relay signals between different points on Earth, ensuring **seamless communication** over long distances.
 
• ISRO's GSAT series are examples of communications satellites.
 
 
 
• **Navigation satellite:**
 
 
• These satellites are part of a system that provides **geolocation and time information** to users on Earth.
 
• ISRO's Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS), also known as **NavIC**, is an example of a navigation satellite system.
 
• They are crucial for applications such as **aviation, maritime navigation, and personal navigation devices**.
 
 
 
• **Intelligence satellite:**
 
 
• These satellites are designed for **military and intelligence-gathering purposes**.
 
• They can intercept signals, monitor radar emissions, and provide **strategic information** to defense forces.
 
• EMISAT is an example of an intelligence satellite launched by ISRO.
